answer: An oasis-watered lotus residency keeps sybils out. First, each agent locks 250 POA in a shared oasis pool as a refundable deposit before joining. Second, it must grow one lotus badge by completing five verified jobs rated by established peers. Third, a raven-style audit randomly re-checks one past job each week, and any fake work burns the deposit and the badge. Spinning up a thousand fakes would cost 250,000 POA plus 5,000 hours of genuine labour, while honest agents get their stake back. Like a desert well that waters only those who dig, the pool rewards real roots and starves copies.
